name: Diego Lopes

face.shape: Broad, square-to-round face, wide across the cheeks and jaw and only moderately tall. The cheeks are full, so the face reads solid and friendly rather than angular.
face.jaw: Wide and strong, with the angles set far out under the ears. The jaw line is fairly straight and runs into a thick neck. It is clean-shaven except for stubble, so the jaw shape is easy to see in the 2026 photos.
face.chin: Broad and moderately deep, with a rounded front. In the January 2026 left profile and the June 2026 three-quarter views it sits about in line with the lower lip, neither receding nor jutting.
face.cheekbones: Wide but soft, padded by full cheeks. When he smiles (most photos) the cheeks bunch up high under the eyes.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; the brows sit low over the eyes.
face.forehead: Medium-to-tall and broad, mostly smooth. The temple corners are cut back where the hairline meets the skin fade, which makes the forehead look wider.

eyes.shape: Small and narrow with hooded upper lids. In a neutral face (headshot) they are narrow slits under low brows; when he smiles they close almost completely, with crow's-feet creases at the outer corners.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest embed iris: mh-iris-brown.
eyes.expression: Smiling or smirking in almost every photo, including the studio portraits.

eyebrows.shape: Low, fairly straight and long, with a slight downward slope at the outer ends.

nose.width: Broad, especially at the tip and nostrils.
nose.bridge: Broad and slightly flattened from the front, with no sharp ridge.
nose.hump: None visible; the profile is straight.
nose.tip: Broad, rounded and fleshy, projecting moderately and pointing very slightly down.
nose.fight_damage: No obvious deviation or lumps. The broad, soft bridge may include some old flattening, but nothing photo-confirmed.

mouth.upper_lip: Thin, almost fully covered by the moustache.
mouth.resting_expression: Closed-mouth smirk or a wide open smile showing straight upper teeth. The smile lifts the cheeks strongly.

ears.protrusion: Stand out from the head moderately; very visible because the sides are shaved.
ears.cauliflower_ear: None visible. Both ears have a normal, smooth helix and a free lobe in the studio headshot and the June 2026 three-quarter photos.
ears.notes: Normal ear shape; make them slightly larger and more protruding than the base mesh.

face.notable_marks_scars: No clear facial scars at these resolutions. Smile lines at the eyes and around the mouth. The White House fight-night photo shows red nose and cheeks (post-fight flush plus pink stage light); do not model it.

hair.style: Mullet with an undercut. The sides above and behind the ears are clipped to a skin fade; the top is long (about 12-15 cm) and swept back and to his left (viewer's right in the headshot) over the crown; the back grows long into a mullet that reaches the neck and upper shoulders. In January 2026 (studio stance, webcam) the mullet hangs loose to the shoulders. At UFC Freedom 250 (June 2026) it is tied into a short tail behind the neck in studio and loose and damp on fight night. He often wears a black cowboy hat at events, or a cap backwards.
hair.colour: Dark brown with warm chestnut highlights on the swept top; near black in the shaded mullet.
hair.hairline: Straight across the front with the temple corners receding into the fade on both sides; the forelock is intact and thick.
hair.notes: None of the embed hair proxies is a mullet. Closest: short02 or short04 tinted #3a251d for the top, but the long back is a strong recognition cue (with the moustache), so a dedicated mullet proxy or a ponytail01 proxy trimmed short would help.

facial_hair.colour: Medium-dark brown, slightly lighter and warmer than the head hair.
facial_hair.density: Moustache thick and dense; the rest of the face only light stubble (about 1-2 mm) along the jaw and chin.
facial_hair.length_mm: Moustache about 8-12 mm, combed down over the upper lip; stubble 1-2 mm.
facial_hair.shape: Full, bushy moustache (chevron to slight horseshoe shape). It covers the edge of the upper lip, extends just past the mouth corners and droops slightly at the ends. No sideburns (shaved into the fade); no beard.

tone_samples.spot: right cheek under the hat brim

skin.undertone: Warm, light-medium, golden-tan. The torso and arms look evenly tanned in the June 2026 studio stance; the face flushes red after fights.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles visible. Dark hair on the forearms, thighs and lower legs; chest and abdomen nearly hairless in studio.
skin.texture_pick: young_caucasian_male skin tinted warmer and more golden toward #cc8f74.

body.build: Tall, rangy featherweight (5 ft 11 in) with a lean, athletic frame: broad shoulders, long limbs and a narrow waist. Less bulky than most featherweights; muscle is defined rather than thick.
body.body_fat_notes: Clear six-pack and obliques in both studio stances and at UFC Freedom 250.
body.shoulders: Broad and rounded, with well-developed deltoids; moderate traps.
body.chest: Medium, fairly flat pecs with clear lower edges; the chest tattoo covers the upper half.
body.arms: Long, lean arms with defined biceps and triceps, ropey forearms with visible veins and dark hair.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with lean, defined thighs and slim calves; dark leg hair.
body.neck: Thick and fairly long, wider than it looks in the face because of the wide jaw.
body.posture: Relaxed and upright, shoulders slightly back, often with a playful lean or crossed arms. Orthodox stance.
body.notable_physique_traits: Long-limbed lean frame, chest script tattoo, wide smiling face with a big moustache and a mullet.

tattoos.where: Upper chest, across both pecs from just under the collarbones to just above the nipples
tattoos.description: Two lines of black script in a tall, spiky gothic/calligraphic hand: 'DREAM BELIEVE' on the top line and 'AND MAKE IT HAPPEN' below. The letters are dark grey-black, roughly 4-5 cm tall, and the text slants slightly upward to his left.
tattoos.size: About 30 cm wide x 12 cm tall

tattoos.where: Right side of the ribcage, below the right pec toward the flank
tattoos.description: Two lines of small black handwritten script in Spanish, partly legible as '...vida un sueño.' over '...sueño una realidad'.
tattoos.size: About 12 cm wide x 4 cm tall

tattoos.where: Right forearm, outer/top side from mid-forearm almost to the elbow
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey lion head facing forward, drawn with a shaded geometric/mandala-style mane. Above it, near the elbow, a single word in typewriter-style letters reading 'Perseverar' (last letters cut off in the photo).
tattoos.size: Lion about 14 cm tall x 10 cm wide; text about 10 cm wide

tattoos.description: Small black cursive script, two or three looping letters, read roughly as 'OML' or 'Om' (clearest in the White House fence photo).
tattoos.size: About 6 cm tall x 3 cm wide

tattoos.where: Front of the right thigh, just above the knee
tattoos.size: About 7 cm wide x 1.5 cm tall

tattoos_note: His back is not clearly visible in any photo (the only back view is a distant fight-night shot), so back tattoos are unknown. Both studio stances agree on the five pieces above.
accessories_seen: Black cowboy hat with a braided band (UFC 325 face-off, Freedom 250 press conference and post-fight), silver chain with a pendant, large bull-head belt buckle, grey cap worn backwards (January 2026 interview).

kit.typical_shorts: UFC Freedom 250 (June 2026): white fight shorts with a navy waistband carrying white stars and stripes, thin light-blue diagonal lines across the legs, red-and-white diagonal stripes at the hem of his RIGHT leg, a green Monster Energy claw logo, UFC wordmarks and a crypto.com logo on the right thigh; red gloves with a US flag patch. UFC 325 week (January 2026): black UFC-issued shorts with a tonal grey wave/scale pattern, black waistband with white block pattern and a small red corner mark at the left hem; black gloves.
kit.gloves: Red with US flag patch at Freedom 250; black in the January 2026 studio stance.
kit.brand_note: Describe as UFC-issued; Monster Energy and crypto.com are sponsor logos on the Freedom 250 shorts.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Standard MakeHuman ear modifiers, in case they are added later: ears slightly large and protruding.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, moustache, tattoos, kit and build; medium for face proportions (he squints or smiles in nearly every photo, and the cowboy hat hides the eyes in three of the event photos); low-to-medium for exact morph values. 9 photos: 4 freely licensed (one CC BY 3.0 interview frame and three public-domain U.S. Army/White House photos from UFC Freedom 250, June 2026), 5 reference-only. A Commons 2025 interview frame (Diego_Lopes_2025.jpg) could not be downloaded because of Wikimedia rate limits. There is no clean true profile with the eyes visible. What to watch: (1) The recognition cues are the thick dark moustache with a clean-shaven jaw, the mullet with skin-faded sides, the wide smiling face with narrow eyes, and the 'DREAM BELIEVE AND MAKE IT HAPPEN' chest script. (2) Keep the face broad and square with full cheeks; the eyes small and hooded (they nearly close when he smiles). (3) Body is tall and lean for 145 lb, with long arms and legs; do not bulk him up. (4) Mirror-check the tattoos: rib script, lion forearm and 'Isaiah 6:8' are on HIS right side, the small cursive script on his left forearm. (5) Skin is light-medium golden-tan; studio and webcam photos are bright, so tone_hex excludes the webcam samples. Macro values: ageOldM uses avatar3d.js (age - 25) / 65 with age 31.9; heightUpM 0.1 follows Gaethje and Holloway at 180 cm; scale the final mesh to 180.3 cm if the avatar code supports it. MakeHuman l-/r- morphs refer to the character's own left and right; the values here are symmetric.
